import csv,hashlib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote
root=Path.cwd(); p=root/'archive/roadmap_history_2026-09-28'
launch=json.loads((p/'LAUNCH.json').read_text()); head=launch['head']
maintained={'LIVE.md','HANDOFF.md','CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md','MEMORY.md','INDEX.md','UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md'}
def git(*a): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*a])
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip()=='grok'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==head
assert set(git('diff','--name-only').decode().splitlines())==maintained
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only')
for name,h in launch['source_sha256'].items():
 raw=git('show',head+':'+name) if name in maintained else (root/name).read_bytes()
 assert sha(raw)==h,name
old=git('show',head+':UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md')
assert (p/'UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP_before_consolidation.md').read_bytes()==old
new=(root/'UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md').read_text()
for prefix in ['> Supernova and other','> galaxies qusars','> In terms of observatble']:
 original=[s for s in old.decode().splitlines() if s.startswith(prefix)]
 assert len(original)==1 and original[0] in new,prefix
section=old.decode().split('## Owner direction clarification — emergence question, 2026-09-13\n',1)[1].split('This current direction qualifies successor language',1)[0].strip()
assert section in new
prog_old=git('show',head+':CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md').decode().split('## Architecture\n')[0]
prog_new=(root/'CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md').read_text().split('## Current next gate\n')[0]
assert prog_old==prog_new,'Founding explanation changed'
files=[root/n for n in sorted(maintained)]+[p/'README.md',p/'WORK_RECORD.md']
checked=[]; missing=[]
for f in files:
 text=f.read_text()
 for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]\n]*\]\(([^)\s]+)\)',text):
  if '://' in target or target.startswith('mailto:'): continue
  filepart=unquote(target.split('#',1)[0])
  resolved=(f.parent/filepart).resolve() if filepart else f
  (checked if resolved.exists() else missing).append([str(f.relative_to(root)),target])
 for target in re.findall(r'`([^`\n]+)`',text):
  if '/' not in target or target.startswith('/') or any(c in target for c in [' ','*','^','=',':']): continue
  if not (target.endswith('/') or re.search(r'\.(md|py|tsv|json|txt)$',target)): continue
  found=(root/target).exists() or (f.parent/target).exists()
  (checked if found else missing).append([str(f.relative_to(root)),target])
assert not missing,missing
rows=list(csv.DictReader((root/'CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv').open(),delimiter='\t'))
assert len(rows)==406
assert not [r['premise_id'] for r in rows if any('UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md' in v for v in r.values())]
package=root/'udt_response_measurement_scaling_2026-09-28'
manifest=json.loads((package/'SHA256_MANIFEST.json').read_text())
for name,h in manifest['files'].items(): assert sha((package/name).read_bytes())==h,name
audit=json.loads((package/'checks/premise_audit.json').read_text()); assert audit['returncode']==0
assert 'PASS' in (package/'checks/premise_audit.stdout').read_text()
untracked=set(git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z').decode().split('\0'))-{''}
outside={n for n in untracked if not n.startswith(str(p.relative_to(root))+'/')}
assert outside==set(launch['prior_untracked_paths'])
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],check=True)
result={'status':'PASS','scope':'editorial preservation and route validity, not scientific proof',
 'baseline':head,'source_pins_verified':len(launch['source_sha256']),'archive_byte_identity':True,
 'founding_block_byte_identity':True,'verbatim_owner_quotes':3,'emergence_direction_preserved':True,
 'checked_local_targets':len(checked),'missing_targets':missing,'prior_RMS1_manifest_files_unchanged':len(manifest['files']),
 'premise_rows':len(rows),'full_audit':'reused RMS1 pass with unchanged premise/verifier/source pins; focused current-surface run is separate',
 'prior_untracked_paths_preserved':len(outside),'protected_payloads_read':False,
 'line_counts':{n:{'before':len(git('show',head+':'+n).decode().splitlines()),'after':len((root/n).read_text().splitlines())} for n in sorted(maintained)}}
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
